body:
🟡🧹 **Consider · cleanup: Panel-named exports now serve the Record page too**

`MicPanelDrawer`, `SystemAudioPanelDrawer`, `CameraPanelDrawer` and `CameraPanelTile` are now used by the Record page with `variant="page"` / `compact={false}`. Their names still say "Panel", which misleads readers of `record-page.tsx`. Consider renaming them (for example `MicDrawer`) or re-exporting under neutral names. The `exclusive` doc comment in `use-settings-disclosure.ts:29-32` also still says it is used by the capture panel only.

🟡🧹 **Consider · cleanup: Over-long doc comment line**

The first line of the `MicSettingsBody` doc comment was merged into one very long line when the word "popover" was removed. Re-wrap it to match the neighbouring comments.
